title: Light Charred Filipino Rice Noodles Pancit Bihon
description: A Whole30-friendly Filipino dish featuring charred and snappy rice noodles, served with a zesty vinaigrette dressing and infused oil.
instructions: Heat the coconut oil in a small saucepan over low heat to infuse with garlic for 10 minutes.
Strain the infused oil through a fine-mesh sieve into a bowl and set aside.
In a large pan, heat the vegetable oil over medium-high heat and char the rice noodles for 2-3 minutes on each side.
Add the sliced onion to the pan and cook until translucent.
Add the patola and other Asian vegetables to the pan and stir-fry for 2 minutes.
In a small bowl, whisk together the apple cider vinegar, salt, and black pepper to make the vinaigrette dressing.
Pour the vinaigrette dressing over the noodles and vegetables, and toss to combine.
Drizzle the infused oil over the top of the noodles and vegetables.
Sprinkle chopped scallions over the dish and serve immediately.
